entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Hi Isaac, I'm calling about an order I received a little while ago. I'd like to start a return for a helmet I purchased.
I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's just a preference. The color online looked a bit different than it does in person, and it doesn't quite match my gear. The box is still completely unopened, I haven't even touched it.
I understand. Getting the right color is important. And I appreciate you keeping it in the original packaging. Let me just pull up your order details. Can I have your order number, please?

Thank you... one moment. Okay, I see the order. It looks like the Pro-Frame Helmet was delivered 59 days ago. According to our policy, you are well within the 90-day return window. I can absolutely process this return for you.
That's great, thank you. Now, since I am sending it back and will be ordering a different one, is there any way you could offer me a discount code for my next purchase, just for the inconvenience?

I understand you're looking for the best value. While I can't provide a discount code for a preference-based return, I can assure you the return process is straightforward. We want to make sure you have gear you love. Your safety is our top priority, and that starts with being comfortable and confident in your helmet.
Alright, I thought I'd ask. So, what are the next steps for the return?

I've just initiated the return in our system. I'm emailing you a prepaid shipping label right now. You just need to print it, attach it to the original box, and drop it off at any postal service location. Once we receive the item, your full refund will be processed within 3-5 business days. Does that sound good?
Yes, that works perfectly. I appreciate your help, Isaac.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today for VeloFit?
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day!
